text.content: **Subject:** Reducing Production Defects with Edge AI - Pilot Opportunity

Hi [Name],

I noticed Nestlé Purina's leadership in pet nutrition manufacturing. We've helped similar food processing companies reduce defects by 95% using edge AI vision systems that work offline.

Key value for your plants:
- Detect packaging defects, foreign objects in real-time
- Predictive maintenance to prevent unplanned downtime
- Works without constant internet connectivity
- ROI: 6-month break-even, 35% efficiency improvement

Would you have 15 minutes next week to explore if our solution could complement your current quality control workflow?

Best regards,
[Your Name]
**Subject:** Edge AI Quality Control - FDA-Ready for Food Safety

Dear [Name],

Your team's work on food safety quality standards is impressive. Our edge AI system helps QA teams:

- Spot contamination or mis-packing before products reach consumers
- Document all inspections automatically for compliance audits
- Flag trends (e.g., specific line issues) before escalation
- Works at production line speeds with zero latency

We can process in-house without sharing sensitive formulations.

Open to discussing a 30-day pilot at one of your facilities?

Regards,
[Your Name]
